rows.text:
Welcome, [Trailblazer]:

My absolute favorite thing is celebrating festivals.
When everyone gathers, singing songs and dancing together.
I wish time would fly by even faster,
so I could teach you fairy dances at our next gathering.

Yet once the celebration starts, I find myself wishing
that time would slow down, just a little bit more.
Not because I want more Lantern Persimmons or Quillorbs,
but simply to enjoy more moments with friends.

Lalimem, who wants to hang out with you
